pitchers.name: Hank Hollister
pitchers.bio: Throws strikes, tells long stories, owns the feed store.

pitchers.name: Dottie Fairweather
pitchers.bio: Learned to pitch by plunking apples off the silo roof.

pitchers.name: Clem Bixby
pitchers.bio: Always delivers. Usually right down Main Street.

pitchers.name: Earl Oxley
pitchers.bio: Farm-strong and grumpy about it. Holds the county record for strikeouts and blue ribbons.

pitchers.name: Vinnie Castellano
pitchers.bio: Will flip you a quarter for every swing and miss. Never runs out of quarters.

pitchers.name: Rosalind Park
pitchers.bio: Grew up throwing at a fire escape six floors up. Rarely misses a rung.

pitchers.name: Marty Pinwheel
pitchers.bio: Throws from the third rail. The ball rises like a train out of a tunnel.

pitchers.name: Lou Brodsky
pitchers.bio: Collects rent on the inside corner, first of every month and every at-bat.

pitchers.name: Ellis Thornbury
pitchers.bio: Splits his own firewood. Would like to split your bat too.

pitchers.name: June Larkspur
pitchers.bio: Her knuckleball flutters like a moth around a porch light.

pitchers.name: Otis Fernsby
pitchers.bio: Paddles to the park every morning. Arm like an outboard motor.

pitchers.name: Gus Haldane
pitchers.bio: Seven feet of flannel. Nobody has ever gotten a clear look at him, or his curveball.

pitchers.name: Pearl Marlowe
pitchers.bio: You hear her before you see the pitch. Mostly you just hear her.

pitchers.name: Nils Brightwater
pitchers.bio: Sticks to the corners and will not be scraped off.

pitchers.name: Sully Tidewell
pitchers.bio: Knuckles nearly scrape the mound. The sinker goes out with the tide.

pitchers.name: Winifred Gale
pitchers.bio: Commands the strike zone like a flagship. Salutes after every strikeout.

pitchers.name: Rio Calloway
pitchers.bio: Spins like a whirlwind on the mound. So does the slider.

pitchers.name: Tess Rattigan
pitchers.bio: Drifts in from nowhere, throws something weird, drifts back out.

pitchers.name: Cosmo Starling
pitchers.bio: Only pitches after sundown. Claims the moon gives him an extra two miles an hour.

pitchers.name: Dez Montoya
pitchers.bio: Now you see it. Now you are walking back to the dugout.

pitchers.name: Augustus Fairchild
pitchers.bio: Plays the stadium organ between starts. Changes keys mid-at-bat.

pitchers.name: Belle Harrow
pitchers.bio: Perches on the mound without blinking. The cutter bites stone.

pitchers.name: Rex Underwood
pitchers.bio: Two pitches, both loud. Catchers ice their hands for a week.

pitchers.name: Cornelius Vane
pitchers.bio: The last ace of the old cathedral. Has never thrown the same pitch twice in a row. Probably.

pitchers.name: Bobby Lobbs
pitchers.bio: Has thrown four million meatballs and loved every one. Gets a little competitive after a few dingers.

pitchers.name: Mabel Quigley
pitchers.bio: Seventy-two years young. Still brings the cookies and the high cheese.

pitchers.name: Ike Penny
pitchers.bio: Delivers to every corner of the zone before breakfast.
